feature.description: the feature this source was added for

normalised_sha.description: sha of the engine-tagged normalised text; gate-intake detects edits

unassigned.description: added while the open feature was past requirements; the next intake --new takes it

superseded.description: an earlier revision of an edited inbox file; specs account for the latest one

references.description: mockups the brief points at (binding design inputs)

path.description: a folder on this machine, or the .html file itself (absolute, or relative to the project); a file reference write-protects only that file

entry.description: the page to open first, relative to path (index.html when it exists)

run.description: the serve command the mockup documents; recorded, never run by the engine

source.description: where the reference was found (an inbox file, or factory reference add)

status.description: proposed = found in the brief, not binding until the human confirms; absent = confirmed

feature.description: the feature this reference belongs to

unassigned.description: found while every open feature was past requirements; the next feature takes it, no open feature is bound by it

pages.description: assembly page ids from prototype/features.yaml; the binding label names pages/<id>.html

states.description: states of those pages, from prototype/features.yaml

intent.description: one line from prototype/features.yaml: what this feature's screens are for
